seo.title: Your Company — canopies and welding work in Tashkent
seo.description: Car and terrace canopies, including ones with solar panels on the roof, mobile welding, and repair of gates and frames. Yangihayot, Tashkent.
seo.answer: Your Company is a welding shop in Yangihayot: single carports from 9,500,000 UZS, a two-car solar carport with 5 kW of panels from 62,000,000 UZS, and mobile welding from 350,000 UZS per call-out. Canopies go up in 2–3 days with a 5-year frame warranty; phone +998 71 200-04-06.

listing.description: A website for a welding shop and canopy installer: the sun over a roof on the first screen, a power calculator, services, packages and stages.

sections.title: Shade for the car, power for the house
sections.subtitle: We build carports and terrace canopies — with solar panels on the roof if you like, so the canopy gives shade in summer and electricity all year.

sections.label: About
sections.title: Welding since 2015 — and now catching the sun too
sections.text: We started with mobile welding of gates and fences. Clients kept asking for canopies, then for solar panels on top. Now we calculate panel and wind loads, weld frames from 80×80 tube and install the system with partner electricians.

items.title: Single carport
items.text: An 80×80 frame with a polycarbonate or metal-sheet roof.

items.title: Solar carport
items.text: A frame for the panels, an inverter and connection to the house.

items.title: Mobile welding
items.text: Gates, wickets, fences and grilles — we bring our own generator.

sections.label: Solar carports
sections.title: Estimate your power and pick a carport

sections.label: Stages
sections.title: From measurement to the first kilowatt

items.title: Measurement
items.text: A craftsman visits with samples, takes measurements and talks through the job. Free within Tashkent.

items.title: Sketch
items.text: We draw a sketch and price the job. We revise it until you like it, at no extra charge.

items.title: Fabrication
items.text: We cut, bend, forge and weld in our own workshop, sending photos at every stage.

items.title: Finishing
items.text: Metal primer plus powder or forge paint, so the finish does not peel after one season.

items.title: Installation
items.text: We deliver and install in a day, clean up after ourselves and sign the warranty.

items.quote: They put a solar canopy over our two cars. The cars stay in the shade in summer and the electricity bill is noticeably lower.
items.author: Farrukh

items.quote: The welder came the same day and fixed the gate in an hour.
items.author: Malika

items.q: Will the canopy carry panels and snow?
items.a: Yes. We calculate panel, wind and snow loads for Tashkent and use 80×80 tube with a margin.

items.q: Can panels go on an existing canopy?
items.a: Sometimes, after an inspection. More often we reinforce the frame, which is cheaper than starting over.
It is a guide based on Tashkent’s average sunshine. We calculate exactly after a site visit.

items.q: How much is a welder call-out?
items.a: From 350,000 UZS per call-out with a generator, then by the scope of work.
